description: This file contains the implementation of serialization, deserialization, and copying logic for the ArrayList type within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It defines a serializer class, a surrogate type, and a copier class for ArrayList.

classes.name: ArrayListCodec
classes.description: Serializer class for ArrayList, converting to and from a surrogate representation.

classes.name: ArrayListSurrogate
classes.description: A surrogate struct used to serialize the ArrayList's data.

classes.name: ArrayListCopier
classes.description: Class responsible for deep copying ArrayList instances.

methods.name: ArrayListCodec.ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate representation back into an ArrayList.

methods.name: ArrayListCodec.ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ArrayList into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: ArrayListCopier.DeepCopy (with input and CopyContext)
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an ArrayList, utilizing the CopyContext.

methods.name: ArrayListCopier.DeepCopy (with input, output, and CopyContext)
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of an ArrayList into an existing output ArrayList.
